g.text: An accepted proposal or goal is saved now and applied at period close
Decision and checkpoint are separate writes.
The saved decision must survive a failed resume.
Acceptance does not change today's limit.
the decision service saves alert status.
Goals: the same shape, per goal (TPC-25)
An undecided proposal expires at the close that opens its start month.
A goal's line starts at that close and ends the month of its target date.
Late decisions get a 409; a failed resume
